Floor-contact rows (lower = nearer): bench base bottom y=967 (nearest), person soles y~731, pedestal bottom ~y699 (hidden behind bench top), paintings' stand bases y~613, small statue base y~588 (farthest). Pedestal top face just visible (camera slightly above ~y550 level). No horizon line visible (white background).
